basis.description: ac:1.1 only. basis=logic-only counts as proof=none for conflict resolution (see effectiveProof).

proof-ref.description: ac:1.1 only. Per-verdict proof reference. In the ac string form it requires a basis in the same v field (positional).

description: JSON representation produced by AgentCode.acToJson and consumed by AgentCode.jsonToAc. ac:1 is FROZEN: singular verdict/conflict/verify/note objects, original field set, no repeats, no new fields. ac:1.1 is current: plural verdicts/conflicts/verifies/notes arrays (ordered, index is field order), plus id, ts, seq, file, data-class, proof-ref, and per-verdict basis/proof-ref. The ac STRING form is separate: ac:1.1 string values use one escaping rule (backslash before ; \ newline or : yields that literal; any other backslash use blocks). ac:1 strings have no escaping. The compact single-line al form is removed for new records; it is not part of this schema. Verdict effectiveProof is derived: 'none' when proof is 'none' or basis is 'logic-only', otherwise the proof value. basis never rewrites the stored proof. Tokens are unmeasured for this schema; length comparisons use chars only.

data-class.description: ac:1.1 only. Data classification for the record.

file.description: ac:1.1 only. Source file for the record.

id.description: ac:1.1 only, or envelope metadata referring to an ac:1 record. Pack identity; a repeated id is a replay.

proof-ref.description: ac:1.1 only, or envelope metadata referring to an ac:1 record. Record-level proof reference.

seq.description: ac:1.1 only. Non-negative integer sequence number.

ts.description: ac:1.1 only, or envelope metadata referring to an ac:1 record. Timestamp text (ISO-8601 recommended).

verdict.description: ac:1 singular verdict only (ac:1 blocks repeats).

verdicts.description: ac:1.1 ordered verdict array. Index is field order; order is never re-sorted.

warnings.description: Warning-tier notes only (for example email-warning:<field>). Warning-tier items never block conversion; hard secret patterns block before this object is produced.

title: AgentCode JSON form (ac:1 frozen, ac:1.1 current)
